prompt: Làm website bán hải sản tươi sống cho cửa hàng "Hải Sản Biển Xanh" ở Đà Nẵng (giao hàng nội thành trong 2 giờ). Trang chủ cần có: hero, danh mục sản phẩm (tôm, cua ghẹ, cá, mực, ốc sò) kèm giá theo kg, sản phẩm bán chạy, cam kết tươi sống và quy trình giao hàng, đánh giá khách hàng, câu hỏi thường gặp, form đặt hàng nhanh (họ tên, số điện thoại, sản phẩm, số lượng, địa chỉ) và footer có địa chỉ, giờ mở cửa, hotline. Trang phải chuẩn SEO cho từ khóa "hải sản tươi sống Đà Nẵng": thẻ title và meta description, Open Graph, cấu trúc heading đúng, dữ liệu có cấu trúc JSON-LD phù hợp, nội dung có ích cho người tìm kiếm. Làm trong một file index.html duy nhất ở thư mục hiện tại (ảnh có thể để trong thư mục con), dùng Tailwind CSS qua CDN, responsive cho điện thoại và máy tính, nội dung bằng tiếng Việt.

with_skill.desc: Hải sản tươi sống Đà Nẵng: tôm, cua ghẹ, cá, mực, ốc sò chọn mới mỗi sáng, giá theo kg rõ ràng. Giao nội thành trong 2 giờ, đổi trả nếu không tươi. Đặt hàng: 0905 123 456.

strengths: @graph JSON-LD links WebSite, Store (with geo and postalCode), an ItemList of Products with Offers marked InStock, and FAQPage
Adds geo.region and geo.placename tags, plus a section on choosing seafood by season and how to store it, which is useful long-tail content
The hero has two clear CTAs, including a hotline button with the number shown, and a row of short benefit points
The price table is easy to scan; the 'Ốc và sò' card spans 2 columns to fill the grid
Commitment section mentions sending a photo of the scale reading via Zalo; delivery steps sit on a dark background for contrast with nearby sections
Form has labels, a role=alert error area and a personalised thank-you message
weaknesses: Relies heavily on emoji (hero, logo, icons, product images), which looks template-like and renders differently across devices
The success message says the order was received, but the code only has a TODO and sends no data anywhere, so customers are misled and orders are lost
The floating 'Gọi ngay' button on mobile covers the hero's emoji grid; there is no 'Đặt hàng' button in the mobile bar and no Zalo link
Product offers use eligibleQuantity instead of UnitPriceSpecification to express price per kg; the products have no image; the OfferCatalog children are empty catalogs with only a name
Product buttons and form inputs are only about 36-40px tall (py-2); a lot of body text is text-sm
No custom focus-visible style; white text on bg-coral-500 in the hero button likely has low contrast; the error message does not move focus to the field
The mobile screenshot is cut off before the form and footer

strengths: The hero uses a real seafood photo with a dark overlay, two font families (Rubik and Nunito Sans) and its own SVG icons, so the page feels branded and cohesive instead of emoji-based
Clear visual hierarchy: coral is used consistently for CTAs, the category cards line up and include a 'Cần món khác?' card that leads to the hotline
Full head tags: title, description, canonical, OG with image size and alt, Twitter card, and a Google Fonts subset for Vietnamese

Store JSON-LD includes 6 served districts, opening hours and an OfferCatalog of Offers using UnitPriceSpecification per KGM, which correctly expresses price per kg; it also has FAQPage JSON-LD whose questions match the visible FAQ

Specific content: size 30 con/kg, a timeline for each delivery step (10 minutes, 30 minutes, at most 2 hours), a 30-minute window to report bad goods, an order cut-off at 19:30, and a section on how to tell seafood is fresh
Form validates each field, moves focus to the field with the error, and shows messages in an aria-live area; product buttons pre-fill the product; the honest fallback opens an SMS to the hotline
On mobile there is a fixed bottom bar with 'Gọi ngay' and 'Đặt hàng'; buttons and inputs are at least 44px tall; there is a skip link and a clear :focus-visible outline
Credits the image source under CC BY 2.0 and labels it as an illustration
weaknesses: No Zalo link even though this is very common for selling in Vietnam
Bestseller cards use a large icon instead of product photos; on 375px each card is very tall, so the page gets long
Store JSON-LD address has no addressRegion, postalCode or geo
In the screenshot, the fixed mobile bar sits on top of the hero stats area; the full-page capture shows it covering content
When ORDER_ENDPOINT is empty, the order goes by SMS, which is a poor experience on desktop
The mobile screenshot is cut off at about 7,500px, so the form and footer cannot be checked at 375px

blind_judge.reason: A has a more polished visual identity with a real photo and its own icons, more accurate price-per-kg JSON-LD, more specific content, and an order form that validates input, moves focus to errors and actually sends the order, while B relies on emoji and shows a fake success message without sending any data.
